pages.text: At the end of the mountain path, they could see the top of a rock. From there, you could see the whole village.
Ppino tightened their shoelaces. "I'll get there first."
Ppino ran ahead. The four walked slowly behind.
There were lots of stones on the path. Ppino ran, looking only ahead.
A foot caught on a stone. Ppino fell forward.
Their knee was scraped. Ppino limped.
The four passed Ppino on their way up. Now Ppino was last.
Grandma Bear cleaned Ppino's knee. "Go too fast, and you don't see the path."
The four came back down. They held Ppino on both sides.
All five reached the top side by side. The whole village lay below their feet.
